info.li: Single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq) data from the Arabidopsis seed-to-seed developmental atlas: Lee, Nobori, Illouz-Eliaz, Jow, Nery & Ecker. A Single-Nucleus Atlas of Seed-to-Seed Development in Arabidopsis. Nature Plants (2025/2026). DOI: 10.1038/s41477-025-02072-z (preprint: bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.03.23.533992). GEO accession GSE226097.

No experimental condition/treatment axis applies to this organ view — nuclei were collected from a single developmental snapshot, so there is no control-vs-treatment comparison. As requested, the relative (log₂ ratio) view is instead centred on the median of all displayed cell-type pseudobulk means for a given gene, matching this tool's existing expression_to_color_relative(median_ctrl, ...) convention already used for the other Lee/Martin datasets. Med_CTRL is a synthetic placeholder representing that computed median, not a real GSM sample.
Tissue ids below are the literal, verbatim id attributes from the corresponding SVG template, confirmed with no synthetic/compound keys.

Samples used: 44-day-old siliques (8 snRNA-seq runs: GSM7063688–GSM7063695). All cell types within this organ share the same set of libraries, since cell type is a post-hoc clustering annotation rather than a separate sequencing run.
